title: Tronox Declares $0.05 Fourth Quarter 2026 Dividend
summary: Tronox declared a quarterly dividend of $0.05 per share, payable January 15, 2027, to shareholders of record on November 16, 2026.
body_markdown:
The release sets the amount at $0.05 per share. It names Monday, November 16, 2026, at the close of business as the record date and Friday, January 15, 2027, as the payment date. It does not state an ex-dividend date, and it does not say whether the amount is higher, lower or unchanged from the company's prior quarterly payment.


## Why It Matters for TROX


The release presents the payment as Tronox's dividend for the fourth quarter of 2026. Tronox, which trades on the New York Stock Exchange, describes itself as the world's leading integrated manufacturer of titanium dioxide pigment. The company says it mines titanium-bearing mineral sands and operates upgrading facilities that produce high-grade titanium feedstock materials, pig iron and other minerals, including the rare earth-bearing mineral monazite.


According to the company, its products include titanium dioxide pigment, specialty-grade titanium dioxide products, high-purity titanium chemicals and zircon, which add brightness and durability to paints, plastics, paper and other everyday products. Tronox said it has approximately 5,700 employees across six continents, and that its vertical integration model and its operational and technical expertise across the value chain position it as the preeminent titanium dioxide producer in the world.
